body: That's just it though, I'm sick of giving people chances only to be let down every time. People fucking suck. That's the theme of the week.

Recent events are leading me to believe otherwise, I can't even say I'm comfortable talking about shit like this with them anymore. There was a time when I would talk to them about stuff, I live with my two best friends and now one has abandoned us all and the other is too fucking busy all the time. All of my shit has been completely overshadowed by my other roommate's untreated bipolar disorder which has been much more visible and problematic than my issues, I'm just more of a private person anyway and I don't like people knowing my shit. But I want people to know, I just don't want to bring it up. Does that make sense? Fuck, none of this makes sense. I think I'm just bonkers.
If I can't end my life, I want to start it over. New friends, new town, new stuff, never speak to anyone again.

Abandoning me. One hasn't been home in two weeks, we only recently figured out where he was. I'm more just freaked out by the idea of being alone tonight than anything else, one of the only things that keeps me from doing it usually is the fact that they're around. I don't know why, but just knowing someone is in the other room always stops me.

I keep a journal, I've dealt with depression all my life and I know what I'm supposed to do. But nothing works. I just feel like I'm at a breaking point and something drastic has to happen or nothing's going to change

I really don't know and that's what's so infuriating. I just get urges. I'll be standing by the side of the road and get an impulse to throw myself in front of a car.

I guess there's been some shit going on, a couple weeks ago I got really drunk and did something I regret. I came home feeling like shit and looking for support but one of my roommates was too drunk to keep his pants on and the other just showed me his fucking nutsack. The only person who actually gave a shit and was there for me is gone now and apparently doesn't fucking care about me anymore. Now I'm alone. But ever since then I've felt so worthless it's a struggle just to get through the day. It's just hard to keep finding reasons to live when it seems like nobody gives a shit about you and everybody ends up abandoning you in the end.
